item.subject: science
item.stem:
Riya ties a small metal nut to a thread to make a simple pendulum for a school activity. She makes a second pendulum of the same length but ties a heavier nut to it. She sets both swinging at the same place with the same small push.
What happens to the time period of the second pendulum compared with the first?

options.A: It increases, because a heavier bob swings more slowly.
options.B: It decreases, because a heavier bob is pulled down more strongly.
options.C: It stays the same, because the time period depends on the length of the pendulum, not on the mass of the bob.
options.D: It changes randomly, because the time period depends on how hard the bob is pushed.
